jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

needs_verification.title: Clinical Data Management Associate II
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Clinical Data Management: Support the implementation and execution of clinical data management plans for assigned medical imaging studies, ensuring data collection and management activities meet project requirements. Study Documentation Review: Review study documentation, protocols, and project requirements to assess their impact on data management processes, standards, and deliverables. Data Validation & Quality Control: Define, develop, execute, review, and maintain edit checks to identify inconsistencies, discrepancies, and missing information while ensuring clinical data accuracy and completeness. Clinical Data Review: Analyze clinical and imaging-related datasets to identify data quality issues, trends, inconsistencies, and potential errors requiring investigation. Data Specifications & System Configuration: Develop and maintain study-specific documentation, including data transfer specifications, system configuration specifications, and data validation requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with project teams and operational stakeholders to support study setup, data collection strategies, and changing project requirements. Issue Management & Resolution: Investigate data discrepancies, coordinate resolution activities, track outstanding issues, and ensure timely follow-up with relevant stakeholders. Reporting & Data Deliverables: Prepare, review, validate, and deliver ad hoc data listings, study reports, and other data-related outputs according to project requirements. Documentation & Compliance: Create and maintain transmittal forms, study documentation, and accurate audit-ready records throughout the clinical study lifecycle. System & Process Improvements: Identify system defects, bugs, and opportunities for enhancements, coordinating with Product Management and relevant technical teams to support improvements. Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular updates on project progress, data quality concerns, potential risks, and outstanding issues to supervisors and project stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to departmental improvement initiatives, standard operating procedure (SOP) updates, and quality enhancement activities. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure data management activities follow internal procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory and industry requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 3 years of experience in Clinical Data Management, clinical research, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), or related healthcare environments. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, clinical data review methodologies, and clinical database management principles. Working knowledge of relational database concepts, data validation techniques, and quality control methodologies. Experience developing or maintaining data specifications, edit checks, data transfer requirements, or clinical study configuration documentation is preferred. Familiarity with clinical research terminology, medical imaging data, and regulated research environments. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate discrepancies and resolve complex data quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Excellent organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical and project-related information clearly. Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. A proactive, professional, and customer-focused approach, with a strong sense of accountability and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. Benefits Competitive compensation package and performance-related incentives. Provident fund benefits. Medical insurance coverage. Flexible remote working opportunities within India. Access to modern office facilities and collaborative working environments. Employee engagement programs and local team events. Professional development and continuous learning opportunities. Career growth opportunities within an international organization. Exposure to global clinical research projects and medical imaging technologies. Opportunity to contribute to clinical studies supporting the development of life-changing therapies. Collaborative and purpose-driven work environment focused on scientific innovation and improving patient outcomes. Maintain CRM data quality and ensure that commercial processes and customer journeys are accurately reflected in the platform. Build and improve automated workflows, lead routing, notifications, and integrations to streamline sales and marketing operations. Support the execution of marketing campaigns, including email communications, lead nurturing, audience segmentation, and campaign tracking. Monitor campaign performance, lead generation, and conversion metrics, identifying opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness. Support lead generation and qualification by researching prospects, organizing leads, prioritizing opportunities, and assisting with follow-up activities. Partner with sales stakeholders to improve pipeline quality, conversion rates, sales activity, and visibility across the sales process. Build and maintain accessible commercial dashboards covering pipeline value, opportunity stages, lead generation, conversion rates, campaign performance, and revenue forecasts. Provide accurate, actionable reporting and analysis to support commercial meetings and decision-making. Contribute to broader revenue operations initiatives, including sales process improvement, forecasting support, commercial analytics, documentation, and sales and marketing alignment. Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements across systems, processes, and workflows. Requirements: 3–5 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, commercial operations, CRM management, or a related field. Strong practical experience with CRM platforms, ideally GoHighLevel, including both CRM administration and marketing automation. Demonstrated ability to build workflows, reports, dashboards, and automated processes. Regular, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude, with curiosity about applying AI to improve productivity and operational efficiency. Experience supporting sales and/or marketing teams in a commercial environment. Good understanding of sales funnels, lead management, pipeline processes, and customer journeys. Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate commercial data into clear, useful business insights. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining accurate data. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with sales, marketing, and leadership stakeholders. Enable and disable data feeds for broker and partner customers in accordance with their licensing agreements and contractual requirements. Respond to data provider audits and inquiries, ensuring that licensing records and supporting documentation remain complete and accurate. Identify opportunities to improve and automate licensing, reporting, and entitlement management processes. needs_verification.title: MDM Analyst
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Follow established standard operating procedures for master data operations, reviewing and updating records related to healthcare providers, healthcare facilities, parent-child hierarchies, and data enrichment. Investigate, validate, and correct master data discrepancies to maintain accurate, complete, and reliable information. Monitor open data quality issues and assignments, ensuring they are addressed within defined timelines. Resolve records and cases in the master data exceptions queue, applying appropriate validation and correction processes. Analyze data using Microsoft Excel and SQL to identify anomalies, investigate inconsistencies, and support accurate data updates. Conduct online research using websites, web portals, and databases to verify healthcare provider and organization information. Escalate complex investigations and unresolved data issues to Senior MDM Analysts or team leads when necessary. Communicate clearly and concisely with team leaders and internal stakeholders regarding data anomalies, investigation findings, and assignment status. Support the Data Management Office in tracking daily activities and maintaining visibility into operational progress. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of master data processes, tools, and workflows to strengthen data quality and reliability. Adapt to feedback and evolving procedures while maintaining consistent attention to detail and operational standards. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, such as a B.Tech or B.E., or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on experience analyzing, validating, or cleaning data in a master data management, data quality, or data analysis environment, including relevant professional experience or internships. Strong investigative mindset, with the ability to identify discrepancies, analyze underlying causes, and develop accurate resolutions. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and quality. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to use data analysis techniques to investigate and validate information. Experience with SQL is preferred; exposure to Python is an advantage. Ability to conduct effective internet research using websites, web portals, and databases. Familiarity with the US healthcare industry, particularly master data management for healthcare organizations, is preferred. Willingness to develop knowledge of master data management practices and the pharmaceutical supply chain. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage assignments and follow through consistently. Flexibility and adaptability when responding to feedback, changing priorities, and evolving processes. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team. Availability to work Monday through Friday on a schedule aligned with US Eastern Time. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement from India. Monday-to-Friday working schedule aligned with US Eastern Time: Approximately 6:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST during US Daylight Saving Time. Approximately 7:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST outside US Daylight Saving Time. US company holiday calendar, rather than the Indian public holiday calendar. Affordable medical benefits. Non-medical employee perks, including Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO). Access to more than 700 professional development and learning courses at no cost. Opportunities to build expertise in master data management, healthcare data, and pharmaceutical supply chain operations. Purpose-driven work supporting data quality and processes that help improve patient access to therapies. needs_verification.title: Marketing Data Analyst & Project Coordinator
needs_verification.description: Marketing Data Analyst & Project Coordinator Rate : Based on experience and competency Are You a Highly Organized Person Who Can Speak 'Data,' Write Technical Documents in Perfect English, and Manage Important Projects to Success on Time? Do you have the "data intuition" to look at a report and immediately spot a trend or a red flag that others might miss? Are you comfortable enough with data jargon that you can "translate" complex analyst-speak into simple, actionable updates for the rest of the team? Have you sat in a meeting about algorithms or user information and walked away with a crystal-clear understanding of the data requirements? Can you take a chaotic, hour-long brainstorming session and turn it into a structured list of tasks, deadlines, and data specs by the time the meeting ends? Are you skilled at "digging for the truth" in a project—asking the right follow-up questions to find out where a bottleneck actually is? Do you pride yourself on being two steps ahead, anticipating the data or documents needed before a meeting even begins? Are you driven by ensuring data integrity and accuracy that serve as the foundation for executive decision-making? Can you constantly focus on how to use all your skills and knowledge to make profit by optimizing our marketing? Do you follow through on the things you start? Can you speak and write excellent English? If that sounds like you, let's talk. We have a perfect role for you. About the Role: You will play a crucial role in streamlining our data operations, acting as the primary filter for communications and data project tracking. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end flow of our data initiatives, from triaging complex emails to ensuring every meeting results in documented, actionable data requirements. Your goal will be to serve as a "second brain" for the team, knowing the status of every data request and ensuring that every team member is both informed and held accountable. Responsibilities: Inbox Triage: Manage email threads, identifying high-priority data requests and answering inquiries on behalf of the team to ensure no communication stalls. Meeting Synthesis & Insights: Attend meetings regarding data analysis; capture complex details and translate them into clear, actionable next steps and summaries. Project Accountability: Proactively follow up with team members to ensure deadlines are met and projects stay on track. Data Documentation: Create and maintain clear records of analytics requests, meeting outcomes, analytic specs, and data requirements so the "truth" of a project is always documented and accessible. Data Literacy & Quality Control: Review post-meeting data results/reports to ensure they align with the decisions made during discussions and flag any inconsistencies. Pre-Meeting Briefing & Intel: Review all upcoming meeting agendas and stakeholder requests in advance to brief the Lead Analyst on the "who, what, and why"; ensure the analyst is armed with the necessary context and that all data outputs are vetted for relevance. Qualifications: Proven Experience: 1-2 years experience in Executive Assistance, Project Management, or as a Junior Data Analyst, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, while being firm about deadlines and proactive about project needs. Strategic Synthesis: The ability to sit in a complex meeting, ignore the noise, and identify the 3–4 most critical analytical takeaways. Attention to Detail: A "detective" mindset. You’ll be responsible for reviewing reports and briefing the Lead Analyst before meetings, catching outliers or errors that others might miss. Adaptability: Ability to work remotely and help manage multiple projects simultaneously with flexibility, can take initiative and be independent with their responsibilities. Cultural Fit: Understanding of and alignment with the company’s values and culture, and being able to act with urgency. Interested? Apply now to join our team and help as a strategic right hand to our Data Lead that will contribute to our company’s success. We look forward to reviewing your application and working with you to elevate our team! Originally posted on Himalayas

needs_verification.title: IT Solutions Analyst
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process mapping involving sales, customer service, manufacturing, and finance teams. Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical solution designs aligned with ServiceNow best practices. Evaluate the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, prioritizing out-of-the-box (OOTB) solutions over unnecessary customizations. Configure, enhance, and support ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), including case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, and knowledge management. Develop and maintain Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) capabilities, including product and quote catalogs, order capture, fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and manufacturing workflows. Design and develop custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Workspaces, and Service Portal. Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony platforms, on-premise applications, and databases using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets. Implement, configure, and optimize ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Build Agent, to improve case resolution, order processing, and agent productivity. Develop test plans and test cases, conduct functional and regression testing, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with relevant stakeholders. Manage deployments across ServiceNow instances using update sets and application repositories while following established change management, release management, and source-control practices. Prepare release notes, technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training. Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 production support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and permanent issue resolution within agreed SLAs. Monitor platform health, data quality, and application performance while proactively identifying process gaps, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement. Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, technical debt reduction, and continuous platform optimization. Maintain solution documentation, data models, process flows, and technical specifications while contributing to product backlogs and Agile sprint planning. Collaborate with architects, developers, and platform owners to ensure compliance with security standards, access controls (ACLs), data governance, and regulatory requirements. Monitor solution adoption and business performance through dashboards and Performance Analytics, tracking KPIs such as case resolution time, order cycle time, and SLA attainment. Mentor junior analysts, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the development of ServiceNow best practices across the organization. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with ServiceNow as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer. Demonstrated implementation and production support experience in at least two of the following ServiceNow modules: Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM). Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements gathering and solution design through deployment and ongoing support. Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, platform upgrades, and release cycles. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification and ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification are required. ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) certifications are preferred. Certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or equivalent manufacturing-focused ServiceNow credentials are a strong advantage. Strong understanding of the ServiceNow data model, tables, access control lists (ACLs), roles, CMDB, and customer service data structures. Proficiency in JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development. Practical experience integrating ServiceNow with Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, JDBC, Integration Hub, MID Server, import sets, and transform maps. Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM, case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK). Working knowledge of agentic AI capabilities, including configuring and governing AI Agents, developing agentic workflows, selecting model providers, and managing Now Assist administration, licensing, and governance guardrails. Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces, particularly Customer Service Workspace. Understanding of business processes such as order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement management, warranty management, and contract management. Familiarity with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe, user story development, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps. Ability to prepare functional specifications, test cases, process documentation, and technical presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions rather than temporary workarounds. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate workshops and explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to balance competing priorities across commercial, customer service, manufacturing, and IT teams. Customer-focused mindset, with an emphasis on measurable business outcomes, solution adoption, and service quality. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced Agile environment. Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore development teams. Additional advantages: Hands-on experience with MCO and manufacturing commercial processes, including contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility. Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions such as ServiceNow SOM, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order workflows, and ERP integrations. Additional certifications in ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence. Experience developing custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create intelligent workflows. Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP platforms such as Oracle Fusion, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and PLM or MES solutions. Familiarity with CI/CD processes, Git integration, source control, and Automated Test Framework (ATF). Exposure to data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Previous experience coordinating projects or mentoring junior team members. Working Conditions: Primarily remote working arrangement, with occasional business travel. Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production incidents. Availability for occasional after-hours support during releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities. Candidates must be based locally within the position's designated location. Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available. Benefits: Primarily remote working environment, offering flexibility in day-to-day work. Opportunity to work with advanced ServiceNow enterprise solutions and AI-powered technologies. Exposure to large-scale digital transformation projects across customer service, manufacturing, and commercial operations. Opportunity to develop expertise in ServiceNow CSM, MCO, SOM, integrations, and agentic AI. Professional development through continuous learning, platform upgrades, and exposure to emerging technologies. Collaborative working environment involving international stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams. Opportunities to contribute to strategic IT initiatives and continuous improvement projects. needs_verification.title: Video Analyst & Quality Check Executive
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Video Analysis and Monitoring: Review CCTV and self-checkout (SCO) surveillance footage to identify suspicious activities, missed scans, product switching, incomplete payments, and other transaction irregularities. Compare video recordings with transaction details to verify potential retail losses and accurately assess customer interactions at checkout counters. Classify reviewed transactions according to established guidelines while meeting daily productivity and review targets. Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks on transactions reviewed by other analysts, verify classifications, and identify missed incidents, reporting discrepancies, and errors. Provide constructive feedback to analysts, maintain quality assurance records, and contribute to improving overall review accuracy. AI Alert Verification: Examine alerts generated by AI-powered video analytics systems, validate potential incidents, and distinguish genuine irregularities from false positives. Identify recurring AI detection errors and communicate relevant findings to the appropriate teams. Data Management and Reporting: Maintain accurate daily productivity and quality reports, record transaction IDs and review outcomes, and update Excel spreadsheets, tracking systems, and internal dashboards. Escalate unusual or critical incidents to supervisors while maintaining strict confidentiality of surveillance footage and transaction information. Team Coordination: Work closely with team leaders and quality assurance colleagues, follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), participate in training sessions, and support continuous process improvement. Requirements Minimum educational qualification of Higher Secondary (12th pass); a graduate degree in any discipline is preferred. Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience are encouraged to apply. Strong observation skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify subtle discrepancies in video footage and transaction records. Basic computer proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Good analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, particularly when reviewing transactions and identifying potential irregularities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings and reporting incidents. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and supervisors. Good time management and organizational skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy while meeting daily productivity targets. Discipline, responsibility, consistency, and willingness to work with repetitive video-review tasks. Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies, tools, and review methodologies. Previous experience in CCTV monitoring, video surveillance, retail operations, transaction verification, quality assurance, data entry, or transaction auditing is an advantage but not mandatory. Familiarity with self-checkout systems and retail transaction processes is considered a plus. Benefits Opportunity to work with advanced AI-powered retail analytics and intelligent surveillance technologies. Hands-on exposure to artificial intelligence, computer vision, and automated transaction monitoring systems. Professional training in video analysis, transaction verification, and quality assurance processes. Opportunity to develop practical technical, analytical, and operational skills. Potential career progression into roles such as: Senior Video Analyst Quality Analyst Team Leader Operations Supervisor Full-time employment opportunity. Opportunity to contribute to improving retail security, loss prevention, and operational efficiency. Coordinate quality workflows: Work with linguists, reviewers, data specialists, and project teams to organize quality assurance activities and maintain consistent delivery standards. Evaluate AI-generated content: Assess Hindi-language model outputs for accuracy, relevance, naturalness, contextual understanding, and alignment with linguistic and cultural expectations. Provide feedback and recommendations: Document recurring issues, communicate quality findings, and recommend improvements to annotation guidelines, review processes, and linguistic standards. Maintain project documentation: Ensure quality reports, review results, feedback records, and project-related documentation are accurate and up to date. Support continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance linguistic evaluation methods, data quality processes, and overall model training effectiveness. Collaborate across teams: Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address quality concerns, resolve project challenges, and ensure alignment with delivery expectations. Strong English communication skills to collaborate effectively with international teams and understand project documentation and instructions. Experience in linguistic quality assurance, translation, proofreading, localization, language annotation, content review, or multilingual data projects. Understanding of AI, machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or Large Language Model (LLM) concepts, with an interest in contributing to AI development. Familiarity with data annotation, linguistic evaluation, content validation, or quality assessment workflows. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic inaccuracies, inconsistencies, contextual errors, and subtle differences in meaning. Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating language quality and AI-generated responses. Strong organizational and coordination abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple tasks, follow detailed guidelines, and meet project deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback and document quality findings. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams. Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and evolving AI data quality methodologies. Additional advantages: Previous experience working on LLM training, AI evaluation, or generative AI data projects. Familiarity with annotation platforms, linguistic quality tools, and data management systems. Experience coordinating language teams, reviewers, or quality assurance workflows. strong_shortlist.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

review_queue.title: Clinical Data Management Associate II
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Clinical Data Management: Support the implementation and execution of clinical data management plans for assigned medical imaging studies, ensuring data collection and management activities meet project requirements. Study Documentation Review: Review study documentation, protocols, and project requirements to assess their impact on data management processes, standards, and deliverables. Data Validation & Quality Control: Define, develop, execute, review, and maintain edit checks to identify inconsistencies, discrepancies, and missing information while ensuring clinical data accuracy and completeness. Clinical Data Review: Analyze clinical and imaging-related datasets to identify data quality issues, trends, inconsistencies, and potential errors requiring investigation. Data Specifications & System Configuration: Develop and maintain study-specific documentation, including data transfer specifications, system configuration specifications, and data validation requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with project teams and operational stakeholders to support study setup, data collection strategies, and changing project requirements. Issue Management & Resolution: Investigate data discrepancies, coordinate resolution activities, track outstanding issues, and ensure timely follow-up with relevant stakeholders. Reporting & Data Deliverables: Prepare, review, validate, and deliver ad hoc data listings, study reports, and other data-related outputs according to project requirements. Documentation & Compliance: Create and maintain transmittal forms, study documentation, and accurate audit-ready records throughout the clinical study lifecycle. System & Process Improvements: Identify system defects, bugs, and opportunities for enhancements, coordinating with Product Management and relevant technical teams to support improvements. Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular updates on project progress, data quality concerns, potential risks, and outstanding issues to supervisors and project stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to departmental improvement initiatives, standard operating procedure (SOP) updates, and quality enhancement activities. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure data management activities follow internal procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory and industry requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 3 years of experience in Clinical Data Management, clinical research, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), or related healthcare environments. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, clinical data review methodologies, and clinical database management principles. Working knowledge of relational database concepts, data validation techniques, and quality control methodologies. Experience developing or maintaining data specifications, edit checks, data transfer requirements, or clinical study configuration documentation is preferred. Familiarity with clinical research terminology, medical imaging data, and regulated research environments. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate discrepancies and resolve complex data quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Excellent organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical and project-related information clearly. Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. A proactive, professional, and customer-focused approach, with a strong sense of accountability and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. Benefits Competitive compensation package and performance-related incentives. Provident fund benefits. Medical insurance coverage. Flexible remote working opportunities within India. Access to modern office facilities and collaborative working environments. Employee engagement programs and local team events. Professional development and continuous learning opportunities. Career growth opportunities within an international organization. Exposure to global clinical research projects and medical imaging technologies. Opportunity to contribute to clinical studies supporting the development of life-changing therapies. Collaborative and purpose-driven work environment focused on scientific innovation and improving patient outcomes. review_queue.title: Endpoint Operations Analyst (L1) – Intune & SCCM
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Provide first-level support for Windows endpoint incidents and service requests. Perform routine checks of device health, availability, connectivity, and configuration. Support device enrollment and provisioning activities by following approved procedures. Conduct initial checks on Intune and SCCM/MECM policy synchronization and device compliance issues. Assist with Windows Autopilot enrollment and endpoint lifecycle activities. Monitor operating system patching status and report failed, pending, or unsuccessful updates. Perform approved software installation checks, deployment validation, and basic troubleshooting. Support routine Windows update checks and post-patching validation. Identify application installation failures and escalate unresolved issues to L2 support. Assist with approved driver, firmware, and configuration update activities. Perform basic checks on device compliance, encryption status, and configuration policies. Identify issues involving BitLocker, device configuration, and policy application, collecting relevant diagnostic information for escalation. Coordinate security-related incidents with the dedicated Defender and Security teams through established procedures. Log, categorize, prioritize, and track incidents and service requests using ServiceNow or an equivalent ITSM platform. Follow approved runbooks and standard operating procedures when performing initial troubleshooting. Escalate unresolved issues within defined SLAs and established escalation procedures. Maintain accurate ticket updates, operational checklists, and shift handover documentation. Coordinate with L2/L3 specialists, Service Desk, Identity, Security, and Application teams. Follow ITIL Incident, Change, and Request Management processes. Support effective handovers across APAC, EMEA, and North America to maintain uninterrupted 24/7 operations. Requirements: At least 2 years of experience in IT support, Windows endpoint operations, desktop support, or device management. Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems and endpoint troubleshooting. Familiarity with Windows updates, software installation, device connectivity, and system settings. Basic understanding of Microsoft Intune and/or SCCM/MECM. Knowledge of device enrollment, configuration policies, and endpoint compliance fundamentals. Basic understanding of BitLocker, encryption, and Windows security configurations. Familiarity with ServiceNow or an equivalent IT service management (ITSM) platform. Understanding of incident management, SLA compliance, ticket prioritization, and escalation procedures. Good communication, documentation, and shift handover skills. review_queue.title: MDM Analyst
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Follow established standard operating procedures for master data operations, reviewing and updating records related to healthcare providers, healthcare facilities, parent-child hierarchies, and data enrichment. Investigate, validate, and correct master data discrepancies to maintain accurate, complete, and reliable information. Monitor open data quality issues and assignments, ensuring they are addressed within defined timelines. Resolve records and cases in the master data exceptions queue, applying appropriate validation and correction processes. Analyze data using Microsoft Excel and SQL to identify anomalies, investigate inconsistencies, and support accurate data updates. Conduct online research using websites, web portals, and databases to verify healthcare provider and organization information. Escalate complex investigations and unresolved data issues to Senior MDM Analysts or team leads when necessary. Communicate clearly and concisely with team leaders and internal stakeholders regarding data anomalies, investigation findings, and assignment status. Support the Data Management Office in tracking daily activities and maintaining visibility into operational progress. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of master data processes, tools, and workflows to strengthen data quality and reliability. Adapt to feedback and evolving procedures while maintaining consistent attention to detail and operational standards. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, such as a B.Tech or B.E., or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on experience analyzing, validating, or cleaning data in a master data management, data quality, or data analysis environment, including relevant professional experience or internships. Strong investigative mindset, with the ability to identify discrepancies, analyze underlying causes, and develop accurate resolutions. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and quality. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to use data analysis techniques to investigate and validate information. Experience with SQL is preferred; exposure to Python is an advantage. Ability to conduct effective internet research using websites, web portals, and databases. Familiarity with the US healthcare industry, particularly master data management for healthcare organizations, is preferred. review_queue.title: Marketing Data Analyst & Project Coordinator
review_queue.description: Marketing Data Analyst & Project Coordinator Rate : Based on experience and competency Are You a Highly Organized Person Who Can Speak 'Data,' Write Technical Documents in Perfect English, and Manage Important Projects to Success on Time? Do you have the "data intuition" to look at a report and immediately spot a trend or a red flag that others might miss? Are you comfortable enough with data jargon that you can "translate" complex analyst-speak into simple, actionable updates for the rest of the team? Have you sat in a meeting about algorithms or user information and walked away with a crystal-clear understanding of the data requirements? Can you take a chaotic, hour-long brainstorming session and turn it into a structured list of tasks, deadlines, and data specs by the time the meeting ends? Are you skilled at "digging for the truth" in a project—asking the right follow-up questions to find out where a bottleneck actually is? Do you pride yourself on being two steps ahead, anticipating the data or documents needed before a meeting even begins? Are you driven by ensuring data integrity and accuracy that serve as the foundation for executive decision-making? Can you constantly focus on how to use all your skills and knowledge to make profit by optimizing our marketing? Do you follow through on the things you start? Can you speak and write excellent English? If that sounds like you, let's talk. We have a perfect role for you. About the Role: You will play a crucial role in streamlining our data operations, acting as the primary filter for communications and data project tracking. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end flow of our data initiatives, from triaging complex emails to ensuring every meeting results in documented, actionable data requirements. Your goal will be to serve as a "second brain" for the team, knowing the status of every data request and ensuring that every team member is both informed and held accountable. Responsibilities: Inbox Triage: Manage email threads, identifying high-priority data requests and answering inquiries on behalf of the team to ensure no communication stalls. Meeting Synthesis & Insights: Attend meetings regarding data analysis; capture complex details and translate them into clear, actionable next steps and summaries. Project Accountability: Proactively follow up with team members to ensure deadlines are met and projects stay on track. Data Documentation: Create and maintain clear records of analytics requests, meeting outcomes, analytic specs, and data requirements so the "truth" of a project is always documented and accessible. Data Literacy & Quality Control: Review post-meeting data results/reports to ensure they align with the decisions made during discussions and flag any inconsistencies. Pre-Meeting Briefing & Intel: Review all upcoming meeting agendas and stakeholder requests in advance to brief the Lead Analyst on the "who, what, and why"; ensure the analyst is armed with the necessary context and that all data outputs are vetted for relevance. Qualifications: Proven Experience: 1-2 years experience in Executive Assistance, Project Management, or as a Junior Data Analyst, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, while being firm about deadlines and proactive about project needs. Strategic Synthesis: The ability to sit in a complex meeting, ignore the noise, and identify the 3–4 most critical analytical takeaways. Attention to Detail: A "detective" mindset. You’ll be responsible for reviewing reports and briefing the Lead Analyst before meetings, catching outliers or errors that others might miss. Adaptability: Ability to work remotely and help manage multiple projects simultaneously with flexibility, can take initiative and be independent with their responsibilities. Cultural Fit: Understanding of and alignment with the company’s values and culture, and being able to act with urgency. Interested? Apply now to join our team and help as a strategic right hand to our Data Lead that will contribute to our company’s success. We look forward to reviewing your application and working with you to elevate our team! Originally posted on Himalayas

review_queue.title: Marketing Data Analyst
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Extract, combine, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources, including Salesforce, HubSpot, web analytics platforms, and advertising channels, using SQL to identify trends and evaluate marketing effectiveness across the B2B funnel. Lead reporting and data management for Salesforce and HubSpot, maintaining data integrity and developing a strong understanding of CRM structures, data flows, and reporting capabilities. Build, maintain, and automate dashboards and reports to monitor key B2B marketing performance indicators, including lead velocity, MQL-to-SQL conversion, campaign attribution, channel ROI, and account engagement. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Operations stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, translate business questions into analytical projects, and deliver insights that support strategic decisions. Conduct detailed performance analyses of integrated marketing campaigns across digital channels, email, events, and content initiatives. Evaluate campaign effectiveness, identify opportunities to optimize marketing spend, and provide data-driven recommendations for future strategies. Apply statistical analysis, A/B testing, and ROI measurement techniques to assess performance and identify opportunities for improvement. review_queue.title: IT Solutions Analyst
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process mapping involving sales, customer service, manufacturing, and finance teams. Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical solution designs aligned with ServiceNow best practices. Evaluate the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, prioritizing out-of-the-box (OOTB) solutions over unnecessary customizations. Configure, enhance, and support ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), including case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, and knowledge management. Develop and maintain Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) capabilities, including product and quote catalogs, order capture, fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and manufacturing workflows. Design and develop custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Workspaces, and Service Portal. Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony platforms, on-premise applications, and databases using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets. Implement, configure, and optimize ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Build Agent, to improve case resolution, order processing, and agent productivity. Develop test plans and test cases, conduct functional and regression testing, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with relevant stakeholders. Manage deployments across ServiceNow instances using update sets and application repositories while following established change management, release management, and source-control practices. Prepare release notes, technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training. Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 production support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and permanent issue resolution within agreed SLAs. Monitor platform health, data quality, and application performance while proactively identifying process gaps, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement. Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, technical debt reduction, and continuous platform optimization. Maintain solution documentation, data models, process flows, and technical specifications while contributing to product backlogs and Agile sprint planning. Collaborate with architects, developers, and platform owners to ensure compliance with security standards, access controls (ACLs), data governance, and regulatory requirements. Monitor solution adoption and business performance through dashboards and Performance Analytics, tracking KPIs such as case resolution time, order cycle time, and SLA attainment. Mentor junior analysts, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the development of ServiceNow best practices across the organization. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with ServiceNow as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer. Demonstrated implementation and production support experience in at least two of the following ServiceNow modules: Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM). Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements gathering and solution design through deployment and ongoing support. Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, platform upgrades, and release cycles. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification and ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification are required. ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) certifications are preferred. Certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or equivalent manufacturing-focused ServiceNow credentials are a strong advantage. Strong understanding of the ServiceNow data model, tables, access control lists (ACLs), roles, CMDB, and customer service data structures. Proficiency in JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development. Practical experience integrating ServiceNow with Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, JDBC, Integration Hub, MID Server, import sets, and transform maps. Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM, case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK). Working knowledge of agentic AI capabilities, including configuring and governing AI Agents, developing agentic workflows, selecting model providers, and managing Now Assist administration, licensing, and governance guardrails. Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces, particularly Customer Service Workspace. Understanding of business processes such as order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement management, warranty management, and contract management. Familiarity with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe, user story development, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps. Ability to prepare functional specifications, test cases, process documentation, and technical presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions rather than temporary workarounds. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate workshops and explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to balance competing priorities across commercial, customer service, manufacturing, and IT teams. Customer-focused mindset, with an emphasis on measurable business outcomes, solution adoption, and service quality. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced Agile environment. Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore development teams. Additional advantages: Hands-on experience with MCO and manufacturing commercial processes, including contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility. Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions such as ServiceNow SOM, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order workflows, and ERP integrations. Additional certifications in ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence. Experience developing custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create intelligent workflows. Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP platforms such as Oracle Fusion, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and PLM or MES solutions. Familiarity with CI/CD processes, Git integration, source control, and Automated Test Framework (ATF). Exposure to data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Previous experience coordinating projects or mentoring junior team members. Working Conditions: Primarily remote working arrangement, with occasional business travel. Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production incidents. Availability for occasional after-hours support during releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities. Candidates must be based locally within the position's designated location. Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available. Benefits: Primarily remote working environment, offering flexibility in day-to-day work. Opportunity to work with advanced ServiceNow enterprise solutions and AI-powered technologies. Exposure to large-scale digital transformation projects across customer service, manufacturing, and commercial operations. Opportunity to develop expertise in ServiceNow CSM, MCO, SOM, integrations, and agentic AI. Professional development through continuous learning, platform upgrades, and exposure to emerging technologies. Collaborative working environment involving international stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams. Opportunities to contribute to strategic IT initiatives and continuous improvement projects. review_queue.title: Video Analyst & Quality Check Executive
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Video Analysis and Monitoring: Review CCTV and self-checkout (SCO) surveillance footage to identify suspicious activities, missed scans, product switching, incomplete payments, and other transaction irregularities. Compare video recordings with transaction details to verify potential retail losses and accurately assess customer interactions at checkout counters. Classify reviewed transactions according to established guidelines while meeting daily productivity and review targets. Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks on transactions reviewed by other analysts, verify classifications, and identify missed incidents, reporting discrepancies, and errors. Provide constructive feedback to analysts, maintain quality assurance records, and contribute to improving overall review accuracy. AI Alert Verification: Examine alerts generated by AI-powered video analytics systems, validate potential incidents, and distinguish genuine irregularities from false positives. Identify recurring AI detection errors and communicate relevant findings to the appropriate teams. Data Management and Reporting: Maintain accurate daily productivity and quality reports, record transaction IDs and review outcomes, and update Excel spreadsheets, tracking systems, and internal dashboards. Escalate unusual or critical incidents to supervisors while maintaining strict confidentiality of surveillance footage and transaction information. Team Coordination: Work closely with team leaders and quality assurance colleagues, follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), participate in training sessions, and support continuous process improvement. Requirements Minimum educational qualification of Higher Secondary (12th pass); a graduate degree in any discipline is preferred. Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience are encouraged to apply. Strong observation skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify subtle discrepancies in video footage and transaction records. Basic computer proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Good analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, particularly when reviewing transactions and identifying potential irregularities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings and reporting incidents. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and supervisors. Good time management and organizational skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy while meeting daily productivity targets. Discipline, responsibility, consistency, and willingness to work with repetitive video-review tasks. Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies, tools, and review methodologies. Previous experience in CCTV monitoring, video surveillance, retail operations, transaction verification, quality assurance, data entry, or transaction auditing is an advantage but not mandatory. Familiarity with self-checkout systems and retail transaction processes is considered a plus. Benefits Opportunity to work with advanced AI-powered retail analytics and intelligent surveillance technologies. Hands-on exposure to artificial intelligence, computer vision, and automated transaction monitoring systems. Professional training in video analysis, transaction verification, and quality assurance processes. Opportunity to develop practical technical, analytical, and operational skills. Potential career progression into roles such as: Senior Video Analyst Quality Analyst Team Leader Operations Supervisor Full-time employment opportunity. human_review.title: Clinical Data Management Associate II
human_review.description: Accountabilities: Clinical Data Management: Support the implementation and execution of clinical data management plans for assigned medical imaging studies, ensuring data collection and management activities meet project requirements. Study Documentation Review: Review study documentation, protocols, and project requirements to assess their impact on data management processes, standards, and deliverables. Data Validation & Quality Control: Define, develop, execute, review, and maintain edit checks to identify inconsistencies, discrepancies, and missing information while ensuring clinical data accuracy and completeness. Clinical Data Review: Analyze clinical and imaging-related datasets to identify data quality issues, trends, inconsistencies, and potential errors requiring investigation. Data Specifications & System Configuration: Develop and maintain study-specific documentation, including data transfer specifications, system configuration specifications, and data validation requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with project teams and operational stakeholders to support study setup, data collection strategies, and changing project requirements. Issue Management & Resolution: Investigate data discrepancies, coordinate resolution activities, track outstanding issues, and ensure timely follow-up with relevant stakeholders. Reporting & Data Deliverables: Prepare, review, validate, and deliver ad hoc data listings, study reports, and other data-related outputs according to project requirements. Documentation & Compliance: Create and maintain transmittal forms, study documentation, and accurate audit-ready records throughout the clinical study lifecycle. System & Process Improvements: Identify system defects, bugs, and opportunities for enhancements, coordinating with Product Management and relevant technical teams to support improvements. Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular updates on project progress, data quality concerns, potential risks, and outstanding issues to supervisors and project stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to departmental improvement initiatives, standard operating procedure (SOP) updates, and quality enhancement activities. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure data management activities follow internal procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory and industry requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 3 years of experience in Clinical Data Management, clinical research, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), or related healthcare environments. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, clinical data review methodologies, and clinical database management principles. Working knowledge of relational database concepts, data validation techniques, and quality control methodologies. Experience developing or maintaining data specifications, edit checks, data transfer requirements, or clinical study configuration documentation is preferred. Familiarity with clinical research terminology, medical imaging data, and regulated research environments. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate discrepancies and resolve complex data quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Excellent organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical and project-related information clearly. Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. A proactive, professional, and customer-focused approach, with a strong sense of accountability and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. Benefits Competitive compensation package and performance-related incentives. Provident fund benefits. Medical insurance coverage. Flexible remote working opportunities within India. Access to modern office facilities and collaborative working environments. Employee engagement programs and local team events. Professional development and continuous learning opportunities. Career growth opportunities within an international organization. Exposure to global clinical research projects and medical imaging technologies. Opportunity to contribute to clinical studies supporting the development of life-changing therapies. Collaborative and purpose-driven work environment focused on scientific innovation and improving patient outcomes. Demonstrated ability to build workflows, reports, dashboards, and automated processes. Regular, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude, with curiosity about applying AI to improve productivity and operational efficiency. Experience supporting sales and/or marketing teams in a commercial environment. Good understanding of sales funnels, lead management, pipeline processes, and customer journeys. Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate commercial data into clear, useful business insights. Perform routine checks of device health, availability, connectivity, and configuration. Support device enrollment and provisioning activities by following approved procedures. Conduct initial checks on Intune and SCCM/MECM policy synchronization and device compliance issues. Assist with Windows Autopilot enrollment and endpoint lifecycle activities. Monitor operating system patching status and report failed, pending, or unsuccessful updates. Perform approved software installation checks, deployment validation, and basic troubleshooting. Support routine Windows update checks and post-patching validation. Identify application installation failures and escalate unresolved issues to L2 support. Assist with approved driver, firmware, and configuration update activities. Perform basic checks on device compliance, encryption status, and configuration policies. Identify issues involving BitLocker, device configuration, and policy application, collecting relevant diagnostic information for escalation. Coordinate security-related incidents with the dedicated Defender and Security teams through established procedures. Log, categorize, prioritize, and track incidents and service requests using ServiceNow or an equivalent ITSM platform. Follow approved runbooks and standard operating procedures when performing initial troubleshooting. Escalate unresolved issues within defined SLAs and established escalation procedures. Maintain accurate ticket updates, operational checklists, and shift handover documentation. Coordinate with L2/L3 specialists, Service Desk, Identity, Security, and Application teams. Follow ITIL Incident, Change, and Request Management processes. Support effective handovers across APAC, EMEA, and North America to maintain uninterrupted 24/7 operations. Requirements: At least 2 years of experience in IT support, Windows endpoint operations, desktop support, or device management. Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems and endpoint troubleshooting. Familiarity with Windows updates, software installation, device connectivity, and system settings. Basic understanding of Microsoft Intune and/or SCCM/MECM. Knowledge of device enrollment, configuration policies, and endpoint compliance fundamentals. Basic understanding of BitLocker, encryption, and Windows security configurations. Familiarity with ServiceNow or an equivalent IT service management (ITSM) platform. Understanding of incident management, SLA compliance, ticket prioritization, and escalation procedures. Good communication, documentation, and shift handover skills. Ability to follow technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, and established security policies. Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and reporting technical issues. Willingness to work rotational shifts in a 24/7 production support environment. Preferred Qualifications: Basic PowerShell scripting knowledge. Exposure to Windows Autopilot and endpoint provisioning. Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID and device registration.
