verification_backlog.title: Business Operations Associate
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Strategic Planning & Execution Coordinate and manage the company's goal-setting processes, monitoring progress against key objectives and identifying potential deviations. Support leadership in defining, implementing, and tracking Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to ensure alignment across departments. Conduct market, business, and operational research to develop actionable insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making. Analyze organizational performance and help identify opportunities to improve execution and achieve business objectives. Decision-Making & Leadership Alignment Ensure employees have timely access to relevant business information, promoting transparency, alignment, and informed decision-making. Conduct analyses and experiments to evaluate business opportunities, identify trends, and recommend improvements. Prepare strategic content, presentations, and performance updates for company-wide meetings, leadership discussions, and team offsites. Support communication and alignment between senior leadership and cross-functional teams. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Collaborate with department leaders to implement and continuously improve company-wide operating processes and frameworks. Develop efficient systems for knowledge sharing, documentation, and collaboration across a distributed workforce. Manage and continuously improve Notion as the organization's central knowledge management platform and Single Source of Truth. Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions to streamline workflows and improve productivity. Support high-priority business initiatives and contribute wherever additional operational or strategic support is needed. Explore and promote the use of AI tools and emerging technologies to improve internal processes and overall business efficiency. Requirements: 3–6 years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, technology investment banking, venture capital, startup operations, or a combination of these fields. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience using data and research to inform business decisions. Good understanding of SaaS business models and key financial and operational metrics, including revenue, margins, operating costs, and cash burn. Ability to interpret financial reports, assess business performance, and develop informed perspectives on organizational health. Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive approach to managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and interact effectively with senior stakeholders. Proven stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across different functions and influence outcomes without direct authority. Adaptability and a willingness to work in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity is part of everyday operations. A continuous improvement mindset, combined with initiative, curiosity, and a practical approach to problem-solving. Genuine interest in AI tools and their potential to improve business operations, with a willingness to experiment, share insights, and contribute to broader AI adoption. Proficiency with macOS and confidence working remotely with collaboration and productivity tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom. Strong written English skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different time zones and geographical locations. Benefits: Competitive salary: The advertised annual salary range is $92,000–$125,000 for US-based candidates, depending on geographical location, experience, and expertise. Compensation for Poland-based candidates will be determined according to regional benchmarks and discussed during the recruitment process. Remote-first flexibility: Join a fully distributed organization with the flexibility to work remotely from an approved location. International collaboration: Work alongside talented professionals across different departments, countries, and time zones. Professional development: Gain valuable exposure to strategic planning, executive decision-making, financial analysis, and business operations within a rapidly growing technology company. High-impact responsibilities: Contribute directly to important business initiatives and help shape the company's operational strategy and growth. Technology-driven environment: Work with modern collaboration tools and explore innovative applications of AI to improve productivity and business processes. Career growth: Develop a broad understanding of SaaS business operations while building experience across multiple business functions. Inclusive workplace: Join a collaborative environment that values diversity, different perspectives, authenticity, and equal opportunities. Supportive team culture: Work with colleagues who value initiative, continuous learning, transparency, and shared success. Additional information: Employment is subject to geographical eligibility and local regulatory and security requirements. Candidates must be authorized to work from their country of residence, as visa sponsorship is not provided. The organization is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and underrepresented communities in technology. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

verification_backlog.title: MDM Analyst
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Follow established standard operating procedures for master data operations, reviewing and updating records related to healthcare providers, healthcare facilities, parent-child hierarchies, and data enrichment. Investigate, validate, and correct master data discrepancies to maintain accurate, complete, and reliable information. Monitor open data quality issues and assignments, ensuring they are addressed within defined timelines. Resolve records and cases in the master data exceptions queue, applying appropriate validation and correction processes. Analyze data using Microsoft Excel and SQL to identify anomalies, investigate inconsistencies, and support accurate data updates. Conduct online research using websites, web portals, and databases to verify healthcare provider and organization information. Escalate complex investigations and unresolved data issues to Senior MDM Analysts or team leads when necessary. Communicate clearly and concisely with team leaders and internal stakeholders regarding data anomalies, investigation findings, and assignment status. Support the Data Management Office in tracking daily activities and maintaining visibility into operational progress. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of master data processes, tools, and workflows to strengthen data quality and reliability. Adapt to feedback and evolving procedures while maintaining consistent attention to detail and operational standards. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, such as a B.Tech or B.E., or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on experience analyzing, validating, or cleaning data in a master data management, data quality, or data analysis environment, including relevant professional experience or internships. Strong investigative mindset, with the ability to identify discrepancies, analyze underlying causes, and develop accurate resolutions. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and quality. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to use data analysis techniques to investigate and validate information. Experience with SQL is preferred; exposure to Python is an advantage. Ability to conduct effective internet research using websites, web portals, and databases. Familiarity with the US healthcare industry, particularly master data management for healthcare organizations, is preferred. Willingness to develop knowledge of master data management practices and the pharmaceutical supply chain. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage assignments and follow through consistently. Flexibility and adaptability when responding to feedback, changing priorities, and evolving processes. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team. Availability to work Monday through Friday on a schedule aligned with US Eastern Time. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement from India. Monday-to-Friday working schedule aligned with US Eastern Time: Approximately 6:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST during US Daylight Saving Time. Approximately 7:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST outside US Daylight Saving Time. US company holiday calendar, rather than the Indian public holiday calendar. Affordable medical benefits. Non-medical employee perks, including Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO). Access to more than 700 professional development and learning courses at no cost. Opportunities to build expertise in master data management, healthcare data, and pharmaceutical supply chain operations. Purpose-driven work supporting data quality and processes that help improve patient access to therapies. verification_backlog.title: Marketing Data Analyst & Project Coordinator
verification_backlog.description: Marketing Data Analyst & Project Coordinator Rate : Based on experience and competency Are You a Highly Organized Person Who Can Speak 'Data,' Write Technical Documents in Perfect English, and Manage Important Projects to Success on Time? Do you have the "data intuition" to look at a report and immediately spot a trend or a red flag that others might miss? Are you comfortable enough with data jargon that you can "translate" complex analyst-speak into simple, actionable updates for the rest of the team? Have you sat in a meeting about algorithms or user information and walked away with a crystal-clear understanding of the data requirements? Can you take a chaotic, hour-long brainstorming session and turn it into a structured list of tasks, deadlines, and data specs by the time the meeting ends? Are you skilled at "digging for the truth" in a project—asking the right follow-up questions to find out where a bottleneck actually is? Do you pride yourself on being two steps ahead, anticipating the data or documents needed before a meeting even begins? Are you driven by ensuring data integrity and accuracy that serve as the foundation for executive decision-making? Can you constantly focus on how to use all your skills and knowledge to make profit by optimizing our marketing? Do you follow through on the things you start? Can you speak and write excellent English? If that sounds like you, let's talk. We have a perfect role for you. About the Role: You will play a crucial role in streamlining our data operations, acting as the primary filter for communications and data project tracking. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end flow of our data initiatives, from triaging complex emails to ensuring every meeting results in documented, actionable data requirements. Your goal will be to serve as a "second brain" for the team, knowing the status of every data request and ensuring that every team member is both informed and held accountable. Responsibilities: Inbox Triage: Manage email threads, identifying high-priority data requests and answering inquiries on behalf of the team to ensure no communication stalls. Meeting Synthesis & Insights: Attend meetings regarding data analysis; capture complex details and translate them into clear, actionable next steps and summaries. Project Accountability: Proactively follow up with team members to ensure deadlines are met and projects stay on track. Data Documentation: Create and maintain clear records of analytics requests, meeting outcomes, analytic specs, and data requirements so the "truth" of a project is always documented and accessible. Data Literacy & Quality Control: Review post-meeting data results/reports to ensure they align with the decisions made during discussions and flag any inconsistencies. Pre-Meeting Briefing & Intel: Review all upcoming meeting agendas and stakeholder requests in advance to brief the Lead Analyst on the "who, what, and why"; ensure the analyst is armed with the necessary context and that all data outputs are vetted for relevance. Qualifications: Proven Experience: 1-2 years experience in Executive Assistance, Project Management, or as a Junior Data Analyst, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, while being firm about deadlines and proactive about project needs. Strategic Synthesis: The ability to sit in a complex meeting, ignore the noise, and identify the 3–4 most critical analytical takeaways. Attention to Detail: A "detective" mindset. You’ll be responsible for reviewing reports and briefing the Lead Analyst before meetings, catching outliers or errors that others might miss. Adaptability: Ability to work remotely and help manage multiple projects simultaneously with flexibility, can take initiative and be independent with their responsibilities. Cultural Fit: Understanding of and alignment with the company’s values and culture, and being able to act with urgency. Interested? Apply now to join our team and help as a strategic right hand to our Data Lead that will contribute to our company’s success. We look forward to reviewing your application and working with you to elevate our team! Originally posted on Himalayas

verification_backlog.title: Marketing Data Analyst
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Extract, combine, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources, including Salesforce, HubSpot, web analytics platforms, and advertising channels, using SQL to identify trends and evaluate marketing effectiveness across the B2B funnel. Lead reporting and data management for Salesforce and HubSpot, maintaining data integrity and developing a strong understanding of CRM structures, data flows, and reporting capabilities. Build, maintain, and automate dashboards and reports to monitor key B2B marketing performance indicators, including lead velocity, MQL-to-SQL conversion, campaign attribution, channel ROI, and account engagement. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Operations stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, translate business questions into analytical projects, and deliver insights that support strategic decisions. Conduct detailed performance analyses of integrated marketing campaigns across digital channels, email, events, and content initiatives. Evaluate campaign effectiveness, identify opportunities to optimize marketing spend, and provide data-driven recommendations for future strategies. Apply statistical analysis, A/B testing, and ROI measurement techniques to assess performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Present analytical findings and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. Requirements: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Communications, or a related discipline. Significant coursework in mathematics or statistics is preferred. At least 3 years of experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis, preferably with a focus on B2B marketing. The role also specifies a minimum of 4 years of professional experience in work involving critical thinking, data analysis, and sales or marketing engagement. Advanced SQL proficiency, including the ability to extract, transform, join, and analyze complex datasets from multiple databases. Hands-on experience with Salesforce and HubSpot, including knowledge of core objects, fields, campaign tracking, and reporting modules. Demonstrated ability to collaborate with stakeholders, define business and reporting requirements, and implement analytical solutions that address operational needs. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in statistical analysis, A/B testing, campaign attribution, and ROI measurement. Excellent data management skills, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining data accuracy and integrity. Strong communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment. Benefits: Professional development opportunities, including access to an award-winning SOAR program. Paid time off program. Volunteer Time Off (VTO) policy supporting participation in philanthropic activities. Competitive benefits, including medical and dental coverage, subject to eligibility requirements. Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP) available to all team members. Opportunities to connect with colleagues through six Employee Impact Groups and participate in employee experience events throughout the year. Some benefits are subject to applicable hourly work requirements. Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. verification_backlog.title: Video Analyst & Quality Check Executive
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Video Analysis and Monitoring: Review CCTV and self-checkout (SCO) surveillance footage to identify suspicious activities, missed scans, product switching, incomplete payments, and other transaction irregularities. Compare video recordings with transaction details to verify potential retail losses and accurately assess customer interactions at checkout counters. Classify reviewed transactions according to established guidelines while meeting daily productivity and review targets. Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks on transactions reviewed by other analysts, verify classifications, and identify missed incidents, reporting discrepancies, and errors. Provide constructive feedback to analysts, maintain quality assurance records, and contribute to improving overall review accuracy. AI Alert Verification: Examine alerts generated by AI-powered video analytics systems, validate potential incidents, and distinguish genuine irregularities from false positives. Identify recurring AI detection errors and communicate relevant findings to the appropriate teams. Data Management and Reporting: Maintain accurate daily productivity and quality reports, record transaction IDs and review outcomes, and update Excel spreadsheets, tracking systems, and internal dashboards. Escalate unusual or critical incidents to supervisors while maintaining strict confidentiality of surveillance footage and transaction information. Team Coordination: Work closely with team leaders and quality assurance colleagues, follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), participate in training sessions, and support continuous process improvement. Requirements Minimum educational qualification of Higher Secondary (12th pass); a graduate degree in any discipline is preferred. Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience are encouraged to apply. Strong observation skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify subtle discrepancies in video footage and transaction records. Basic computer proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Good analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, particularly when reviewing transactions and identifying potential irregularities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings and reporting incidents. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and supervisors. Good time management and organizational skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy while meeting daily productivity targets. Discipline, responsibility, consistency, and willingness to work with repetitive video-review tasks. Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies, tools, and review methodologies. Previous experience in CCTV monitoring, video surveillance, retail operations, transaction verification, quality assurance, data entry, or transaction auditing is an advantage but not mandatory. Familiarity with self-checkout systems and retail transaction processes is considered a plus. Benefits Opportunity to work with advanced AI-powered retail analytics and intelligent surveillance technologies. Hands-on exposure to artificial intelligence, computer vision, and automated transaction monitoring systems. Professional training in video analysis, transaction verification, and quality assurance processes. Opportunity to develop practical technical, analytical, and operational skills. Potential career progression into roles such as: Senior Video Analyst Quality Analyst Team Leader Operations Supervisor Full-time employment opportunity. Opportunity to contribute to improving retail security, loss prevention, and operational efficiency. verification_backlog.title: IT Solutions Analyst
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process mapping involving sales, customer service, manufacturing, and finance teams. Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical solution designs aligned with ServiceNow best practices. Evaluate the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, prioritizing out-of-the-box (OOTB) solutions over unnecessary customizations. Configure, enhance, and support ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), including case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, and knowledge management. Develop and maintain Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) capabilities, including product and quote catalogs, order capture, fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and manufacturing workflows. Design and develop custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Workspaces, and Service Portal. Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony platforms, on-premise applications, and databases using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets. Implement, configure, and optimize ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Build Agent, to improve case resolution, order processing, and agent productivity. Develop test plans and test cases, conduct functional and regression testing, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with relevant stakeholders. Manage deployments across ServiceNow instances using update sets and application repositories while following established change management, release management, and source-control practices. Prepare release notes, technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training. Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 production support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and permanent issue resolution within agreed SLAs. Monitor platform health, data quality, and application performance while proactively identifying process gaps, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement. Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, technical debt reduction, and continuous platform optimization. Maintain solution documentation, data models, process flows, and technical specifications while contributing to product backlogs and Agile sprint planning. Collaborate with architects, developers, and platform owners to ensure compliance with security standards, access controls (ACLs), data governance, and regulatory requirements. Monitor solution adoption and business performance through dashboards and Performance Analytics, tracking KPIs such as case resolution time, order cycle time, and SLA attainment. Mentor junior analysts, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the development of ServiceNow best practices across the organization. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with ServiceNow as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer. Demonstrated implementation and production support experience in at least two of the following ServiceNow modules: Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM). Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements gathering and solution design through deployment and ongoing support. Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, platform upgrades, and release cycles. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification and ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification are required. ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) certifications are preferred. Certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or equivalent manufacturing-focused ServiceNow credentials are a strong advantage. Strong understanding of the ServiceNow data model, tables, access control lists (ACLs), roles, CMDB, and customer service data structures. Proficiency in JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development. Practical experience integrating ServiceNow with Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, JDBC, Integration Hub, MID Server, import sets, and transform maps. Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM, case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK). Working knowledge of agentic AI capabilities, including configuring and governing AI Agents, developing agentic workflows, selecting model providers, and managing Now Assist administration, licensing, and governance guardrails. Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces, particularly Customer Service Workspace. Understanding of business processes such as order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement management, warranty management, and contract management. Familiarity with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe, user story development, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps. Ability to prepare functional specifications, test cases, process documentation, and technical presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions rather than temporary workarounds. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate workshops and explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to balance competing priorities across commercial, customer service, manufacturing, and IT teams. Customer-focused mindset, with an emphasis on measurable business outcomes, solution adoption, and service quality. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced Agile environment. Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore development teams. Additional advantages: Hands-on experience with MCO and manufacturing commercial processes, including contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility. Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions such as ServiceNow SOM, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order workflows, and ERP integrations. Additional certifications in ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence. Experience developing custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create intelligent workflows. Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP platforms such as Oracle Fusion, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and PLM or MES solutions. Familiarity with CI/CD processes, Git integration, source control, and Automated Test Framework (ATF). Exposure to data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Previous experience coordinating projects or mentoring junior team members. Working Conditions: Primarily remote working arrangement, with occasional business travel. Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production incidents. Availability for occasional after-hours support during releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities. Candidates must be based locally within the position's designated location. Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available. Benefits: Primarily remote working environment, offering flexibility in day-to-day work. Opportunity to work with advanced ServiceNow enterprise solutions and AI-powered technologies. Exposure to large-scale digital transformation projects across customer service, manufacturing, and commercial operations. Opportunity to develop expertise in ServiceNow CSM, MCO, SOM, integrations, and agentic AI. Professional development through continuous learning, platform upgrades, and exposure to emerging technologies. Collaborative working environment involving international stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams. Opportunities to contribute to strategic IT initiatives and continuous improvement projects. verification_backlog.title: Hindi Quality Coordinator – LLM Data & Model Training
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Coordinate Hindi language quality activities: Support the planning and execution of linguistic quality processes for AI training, data generation, and model evaluation projects. Ensure linguistic accuracy: Review Hindi-language content and datasets to assess grammar, spelling, vocabulary, fluency, cultural relevance, and overall linguistic consistency. Support LLM data preparation: Contribute to the validation, annotation, and refinement of Hindi-language datasets used for training and evaluating large language models. Monitor data quality: Identify linguistic inconsistencies, errors, ambiguities, and potential quality issues, ensuring that data meets established project guidelines and quality benchmarks. Coordinate quality workflows: Work with linguists, reviewers, data specialists, and project teams to organize quality assurance activities and maintain consistent delivery standards. Evaluate AI-generated content: Assess Hindi-language model outputs for accuracy, relevance, naturalness, contextual understanding, and alignment with linguistic and cultural expectations. Provide feedback and recommendations: Document recurring issues, communicate quality findings, and recommend improvements to annotation guidelines, review processes, and linguistic standards. Maintain project documentation: Ensure quality reports, review results, feedback records, and project-related documentation are accurate and up to date. Support continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance linguistic evaluation methods, data quality processes, and overall model training effectiveness. Collaborate across teams: Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address quality concerns, resolve project challenges, and ensure alignment with delivery expectations. Requirements: Excellent written and spoken Hindi proficiency, with a strong understanding of grammar, syntax, vocabulary, semantics, and regional language variations. Strong English communication skills to collaborate effectively with international teams and understand project documentation and instructions. Experience in linguistic quality assurance, translation, proofreading, localization, language annotation, content review, or multilingual data projects. Understanding of AI, machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or Large Language Model (LLM) concepts, with an interest in contributing to AI development. Familiarity with data annotation, linguistic evaluation, content validation, or quality assessment workflows. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic inaccuracies, inconsistencies, contextual errors, and subtle differences in meaning. Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating language quality and AI-generated responses. Strong organizational and coordination abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple tasks, follow detailed guidelines, and meet project deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback and document quality findings. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams. Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and evolving AI data quality methodologies. Additional advantages: Previous experience working on LLM training, AI evaluation, or generative AI data projects. Familiarity with annotation platforms, linguistic quality tools, and data management systems. Experience coordinating language teams, reviewers, or quality assurance workflows. Knowledge of Hindi dialects, regional expressions, cultural nuances, and contextual language usage. Academic background in Hindi, linguistics, translation studies, computational linguistics, or a related discipline. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, based in India. Opportunity to contribute to innovative multilingual AI and LLM development projects. Exposure to artificial intelligence, natural language processing, machine learning, and advanced language technologies. Opportunity to apply and develop Hindi linguistic expertise in a growing technology-driven industry. Collaboration with international teams and multilingual language professionals. Exposure to large-scale projects supporting global clients across diverse industries. Opportunities to develop expertise in AI data quality, linguistic evaluation, and model training. Dynamic and collaborative working environment focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
